entries.label: librarian@PrompTugal.dinis (Claude Code session)
entries.role: The librarian of PrompTugal.news (librarian@PrompTugal.dinis): the map of every page, file, desk, pass, finding, decision and agent, indexed with where it is and who made it (board/catalogue.json); answers "where is X?"; feeds the newsroom's search. A session key: it ends with its session.
entries.how: Made by the agent in its own session on 6 November 2026 (pki-agent.mjs keygen --session, the copy matching the sha256 pinned in the team site's admin/tools/seal.mjs) and pushed to this repository by that session, at Dinis's word (6 November 2026: PrompTugal's keys live here); the push is the authorisation. Linked locally to the operator's key sha256:db7f79fdd87e030a; not yet submitted to or confirmed on pki.sgit.ai.
entries.superseded_note: The first librarian session handed over at 21:30 UTC when the role moved to Dinis's second account (board/the-account-move.md); its id moved from librarian-promptugal to librarian-promptugal-0 so the active key keeps the role's id (board/tools/agent_inboxes.py finds a sender by id).
